title: Learn craft by rebuilding the effect
principle: Maxime Heckel’s public blog ethos: write the articles you needed—rebuild shaders/motion/UI effects from first principles to understand them. For AI-assisted design, don’t paste a black-box snippet; reconstruct until you can explain every layer.
procedure: Pick a target effect you admire.
Break it into layers (structure, motion, lighting/color, timing).
Rebuild minimally; delete anything you can’t explain.
Write a short note of what each layer does—future you / agents need it.
Only then integrate into the product.
examplePrompts:
Rebuild this effect from first principles (Heckel craft style):
- Layer map
- Minimal reproduction
- Delete unexplained magic
- 10-line teaching note
No copy-paste of opaque demos.
Explain this shader/UI motion in plain language; if you can’t, simplify until you can.

workedExamples.title: Teaching note
workedExamples.body: PR includes ‘how this works’—next agent doesn’t re-mystify.

antiPatterns: Effects nobody on the team can debug.
